about:
Reverses user inputs! doing nothing holds, holding = releases

### <cr>IT WILL BE OFF BY DEFAULT SO ENABLE IT VIA MOD SETTINGS OR ECLIPSE MENU!</cr>

### Credits:
- [MalikHw47](https://youtube.com/@MalikHw47) - Mod Creator
- [HelloHelloHello](https://www.youtube.com/@hello_hello_hello_gd) - Logo
- Nightzack18 - Mod Idea

report issues [here](https://github.com/MalikHw/FuckedInputs/issues)

---
### Using the Eclipse menu label

I gave you a RIFT variable for use in Eclipse Menu labels:

Adding {{isReversedInputs}{ will show true or false

**Example usage:**
```
{ isReversedInputs == true ? "Reversed Inputs ON" : "No Trolls" }
```
this makes it show "Reversed Inputs ON" when its on, otherwise shows "No Trolls"

More in [Eclipse Labels docs](https://github.com/EclipseMenu/EclipseMenu/blob/main/LABELS.md).
